rss: Anthropic unveils details of planned historic stock market debut
title: Robot Company Plans Big Market Debut
story: The robot company, ROBO, is getting ready to join the stock market. Everyone is talking about how this could be really big and exciting!
storyBig: ROBO, a leading company in robotics, is preparing for its initial public offering (IPO), marking a significant milestone in the tech industry. This move reflects the growing interest and investment in robotics and artificial intelligence.
think: What do you think happens when a company joins the stock market?
bull: This could make ROBO even more famous!
bear: If they don't succeed, it could be risky.

rss: Big, noisy and coming to a town near you - why the data centre backlash is growing
title: Data Centers Worry Green Team
story: Data centers are important for games and videos, but they use a lot of energy. Some people are worried about their effect on the planet.
storyBig: Data centers, essential for digital services, face scrutiny over their environmental impact due to high energy consumption. This raises concerns about sustainability amid growing data demands.
think: How can we balance technology needs and taking care of the Earth?
bull: Data centers help us play more games!
bear: Too many data centers might harm the environment.
